name: Business Academy Aarhus
about: Business Academy Aarhus is a practice-oriented business academy in Viby, south of Aarhus. Its English first-year option is Multimedia Design, a two-year AP combining web and interface design, front-end programming and a company internship. The academy emphasises small classes, group projects and work with companies.

languageOfInstruction.note: Multimedia Design is the English first-year AP. Digital Concept Development requires prior higher education and has its final intake in August 2027; it is not a progression route for AP entrants in 2027.

sources.title: BAAA is a practice-oriented applied institution with one English first-year AP and one existing top-up.
The responsible register lists Erhvervsakademi Aarhus as a state-financed self-governing business academy.
Positive institutional accreditation runs through 30 September 2027.
sources.quote: Structured restatement: Decision dated 1 October 2021: positive institutional accreditation awarded on 30 September 2021 and valid through 30 September 2027.

sources.title: Multimedia Design is the English first-year AP at Sønderhøj 30, Viby J, with a confirmed 30 August 2027 start.
sources.quote: Structured restatement: Two years, English throughout; UX/UI, frontend programming and AI. Semester credits total 120 ECTS, plus 10 extra programming ECTS. Ten-week internship. Campus Sønderhøj 30, Viby J; admission area 81565. Start Monday 30 August 2027. English C and Mathematics C or Economics C; foreign qualifications apply by 15 March noon. Mandatory second-semester trip about EUR 550.

sources.title: The existing top-up has its final intake in August 2027; it cannot be promised to AP students entering in 2027.
sources.quote: Structured restatement: Digital Concept Development remains an AP-entry top-up with final intake August 2027. Multimedia Design explicitly excludes AP entrants from August 2026 onward from the existing 1.5-year top-ups. No replacement bachelor pathway for this cohort is established.

sources.title: English B, or English C plus an accepted test, supplies language proof; tests are valid for two years.
sources.quote: Structured restatement: English C: 125 hours; B: 210 hours during the last three upper-secondary years. Accepted minimums: IELTS Academic/Indicator 6.5; TOEFL/iBT Home Edition 4.5 or 94; Cambridge C1 Advanced 180; C2 Proficiency 200; Oxford Online Placement C1 with at least 85 in each part, only at BAAA or approved partners. Tests valid two years.

sources.title: BAAA exempts Danish/EU/EEA students and listed Danish permits; others pay EUR 6,000 per semester under its schedule valid from 2026.
sources.quote: Structured restatement: Exempt: Danish/EU/EEA, permanent residence, temporary residence permitting permanence (mhp./mmf. varigt ophold), listed §7(1–3), §8(1–2), §9(1), §9c(1) permits. Others pay full tuition. Multimedia Design EUR 6,000 per semester / EUR 24,000 programme, valid from 2026; pay each semester before it starts. Trips, materials and living costs extra.

sources.title: The general exam-completion date is 5 July, but final diploma upload follows individual instructions; the exact May 2027 IB process remains unsettled.
sources.quote: Structured restatement: The qualifying exam must be passed by 5 July. Final diploma can be uploaded later according to admissions-period instructions. The attachments page allows latest transcript for later graduates. The BAAA-specific 2027 IB results-service code, predicted-grade deadline and any dated final-results exception are not confirmed here; follow the academy's document instructions.

sources.title: The live August 2027 calendar confirms opening, main offers, acceptance and study start.
sources.quote: Structured restatement: Study start in August 2027: 1 February opening; 28 July admission letters; 1 August 23:59 accept place; 30 August study start. Conditional vacancies: non-Danish qualifying exams apply by 1 August noon; Danish exams by 9 August noon. Welcome letter 23 August; orientation in preceding week.

sources.title: Special application conditions depend on citizenship, qualification country, residence and finishing school in Denmark, separately from fee exemptions.
sources.quote: Structured restatement: Special route: non-EU citizenship OR non-EU exam. Generally complete exam before application deadline; exception for permanent/permanence-eligible residence (including EU citizens) finishing high school in Denmark. Fee-liable applicants finish before 15 March. EUR 150 fee for non-EU citizens unless exempt; receipt due 15 March noon; payment link still says 2026. Refund if admitted, tuition paid and enrolled 1 October. Qualified special-route applicants have online interview. No Danish residence permit: answer before 1 May; permit holders: 28 July.

notes: AP entrants from August 2026 onward cannot continue to the existing 18-month bachelor top-ups. Digital Concept Development’s last intake is August 2027; a replacement bachelor route for the 2027 AP cohort is not confirmed.

Submit your latest transcript, BAAA’s school-signed verification form and photo ID with the application. The final diploma follows receipt under admissions instructions; confirm how May 2027 IB results meet the stated 5 July exam-completion rule.

Tuition exemptions include EU/EEA citizenship and specified Danish residence permits. Other students pay EUR 6,000 per semester under the schedule valid from 2026. Positive institutional accreditation runs through 30 September 2027.

requirements.label: IB Diploma, or qualifying DP Course Results

officialWording.text: IB-elever uden IB Diploma, men med mindst 18 point (Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results), har adgang til videregående uddannelser i Danmark på lige vilkår med ansøgere med den 2-årige hf-eksamen uden overbygning. Det kræver, at alle 6 IB-fag (3 HL-fag og 3 SL- eller 4 HL-fag og 2 SL-fag) er bestået med mindst karakteren 3. Det betyder, at de har adgang til at søge optagelse på erhvervsakademi- og professionsbacheloruddannelser gennem kvote 1 og 2.

requirements.note: The national recognition rule admits an IB Diploma or DP Course Results with at least 18 points, grade 3 in all six subjects and at least three HL subjects to academy profession programmes through quotas 1 and 2. BAAA directs international applicants to the official qualification handbook; its own page does not separately describe Course Results. Subject requirements remain mandatory. Special non-EU application conditions and final-result timing require separate checks.

sources.title: DP Course Results (formerly the IB Certificate) of at least 18 points, with at least grade 3 in all six subjects and at least three subjects at HL, are a qualifying examination in Denmark on the same terms as a two-year hf without overbygning: they give access to erhvervsakademi- and professionsbachelor programmes through quota 1 and quota 2, and to a university bachelor only after two successive raises of upper-secondary subject level, at least one to A level, taken as hf-enkeltfag. Course Results under 18 points, or containing any subject at grade 1 or 2, are not a qualifying examination at all. A full IB Diploma of 24 points or more gives access to every higher education programme in Denmark.
sources.quote: IB-elever uden IB Diploma, men med mindst 18 point (Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results), har adgang til videregående uddannelser i Danmark på lige vilkår med ansøgere med den 2-årige hf-eksamen uden overbygning. Det kræver, at alle 6 IB-fag (3 HL-fag og 3 SL- eller 4 HL-fag og 2 SL-fag) er bestået med mindst karakteren 3. Det betyder, at de har adgang til at søge optagelse på erhvervsakademi- og professionsbacheloruddannelser gennem kvote 1 og 2. Ansøgere med et Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results på mindst 18 point og mindst karakteren 3 i alle fag kan derudover få adgang til en universitetsbacheloruddannelse gennem kvote 1 og 2 ved enten at supplere med enkeltfag efter samme regler som hf’erne eller tage deres IB-eksamen om for at få et IB Diploma – Retake.

sources.quote: Structured restatement: Digital Concept Development remains an AP-entry top-up with final intake August 2027. Multimedia Design explicitly excludes AP entrants from August 2026 onward from the existing 1.5-year top-ups. No replacement bachelor pathway for this cohort is established.
